definitions.explanation: A rank in the Japanese police force, below inspector (警部) and above sergeant (巡査部長). Roughly equivalent to a police sergeant or detective in English-speaking countries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧{警部補|けいぶほ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Assistant Inspector Tanaka is in charge of the case.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{警部補|けいぶほ}になった。
examples.english: I was promoted to assistant inspector.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{刑事|けいじ}→刑事：02741_keiji⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{警部補|けいぶほ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{主人公|しゅじんこう}→主人公：11404_shujinkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{描|えが}かれる→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: In Japanese detective dramas, assistant inspectors often serve as the protagonist, and they are frequently depicted investigating at the scene.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{警部|けいぶ}→警部：24547_keibu⟧ (police inspector) and {補|ほ} (assistant, deputy). This is one of the most frequently encountered police ranks in Japanese crime fiction and television dramas.

The Japanese police rank hierarchy from bottom to top: ⟦{巡査|じゅんさ}→巡査：04276_junsa⟧ → {巡査部長|じゅんさぶちょう} → {警部補|けいぶほ} → ⟦{警部|けいぶ}→警部：24547_keibu⟧ → {警視|けいし} → {警視正|けいしせい}. The {警部補|けいぶほ} rank is notable because it is the highest rank that can be reached through promotion from the rank-and-file path.

JAPANESE POLICE RANKS:
- ⟦{巡査|じゅんさ}→巡査：04276_junsa⟧: police officer (lowest rank)
- {巡査部長|じゅんさぶちょう}: sergeant
- {警部補|けいぶほ}: assistant inspector
- ⟦{警部|けいぶ}→警部：24547_keibu⟧: inspector
- {警視|けいし}: superintendent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{警部|けいぶ}→警部：24547_keibu⟧: police inspector — one rank above
- ⟦{刑事|けいじ}→刑事：02741_keiji⟧: detective — a job title rather than a rank; detectives are typically {巡査部長|じゅんさぶちょう} or {警部補|けいぶほ} rank
- ⟦{巡査|じゅんさ}→巡査：04276_junsa⟧: police officer — the entry-level rank
